scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,app "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:app"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently -k -n server,app "npm run dev:server" "npm --prefix app run tauri android dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:app
scripts.build:android: npm --prefix app run tauri android build -- --apk --debug --target aarch64
scripts.test: cd core && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cd ../server && go vet ./... && go test ./... && cd .. && npm --prefix app run build
